[Budha+ṇya]  CL=7 (1) The four noble truths that are worth knowing. (2) The cultivation (or development) of the Bojjhaṅas (factors of enlightenment).
[Budha+ya. Nirutti, nhā, 29,535].
bojjhaṅga:
[Bodhi+aṅga]  CL=7 The seven factors of enlightenment (bojjhaṅga), which include mindfulness and the cultivation of wisdom, are applicable truths: (1)
for knowing the Dhamma, (2) for awakening from the sleep of ignorance, (3) for realizing Nibbāna. Therefore, these Bojjhaṅga constitute the parts or elements of Bodhi. The Bojjhaṅga is the basis for becoming an Ariya (noble one).
[Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 176. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 262. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 296.]

bojjhaṅgaratanapaṭilābha: [Bojjhaṅgaratana+paṭilābha] (pu) CL=9 Acquisition of the jewel of enlightenment factor.
bojjhaṅgaratanissara: [Bojjhaṅgaratana+issara] (ti) CL=9 Who governs the jewel of enlightenment factor; one.
bojjhaṅgasampayutta: [Bojjhaṅga+sampayutta] (ti) CL=9 Associated with the factor of enlightenment. See Bojjhaṅgavippayutta.
bojjhaṅgasamuṭṭhāpaka: [Bojjhaṅga+samuṭṭhāpaka] (ti) CL=9 Samuṭṭhāpikā in the feminine gender.] That gives rise to the factor of enlightenment.
bojjhaṅgattha: [Bojjhaṅga+attha] (pu) CL=9 Meaning of the word Bojjhaṅga.
bojjhaṅgatthaniddesa: [Bojjhaṅgattha+niddesa] (pu) CL=0 To expand the meaning of the factor of enlightenment.
bojjhaṅgavibhaṅga: [Bojjhaṅga+vibhaṅga] (pu) CL=8 Chapter on Criticism of the Factor of Enlightenment
bojjhaṅgavibhāvanañāṇa: [Bojjhaṅgavibhāvana+ñāṇa] (na) CL=8 Wisdom that clearly shows the factor of enlightenment.
bojjhaṅgavippayutta: [Bojjhaṅga+vippayutta] (ti) CL=8 Dissociated with the factor of enlightenment.
bojjhaṅgaḷa: [Bojjhaṅga+attha] (pu) CL=8 The meaning of the word Bojjhaṅga
bojjhaṅgupekkhā: [Bojjhaṅga+upekkhā] (thī) CL=9 The indifference that is Bojjhaṅga, negligence that is the cause of magga/path.
bojjhaṅgābhisamaya:
[Bojjhaṅga+abhisamaya]  CL=7 Bojjhaṅgābhisamaya: the realization or attainment of the factors of enlightenment, which leads to knowledge. See – Maggābhisamaya.
[Niyyānaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgābhisamayo. Paṭisaṃ. 393.]
bojjhā:

[Athakho bojjhā upāsikā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. Aṃ, 3. 88.]
